description: Renames the schema-scoped types via directives, two of them while columns are typed by them. The policy is Allow rather than Error because renaming a type a column uses also re-states that column's type, which counts as a destructive AlterColumn even though the rename already carried it. SQL Server sees only the two types it has.

sqlite.because: SQLite has none of these types, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
